label: Navy & Gilt
description: Deep midnight navy with a burnished gilt accent on a cool near-white. Built for real estate, land development and property firms whose own branding is gold-on-navy.
notes: Sampled from the client's own logo: the navy is #04182F-#021B44 and the gold is #C49539. The gold is kept EXACTLY as-is wherever it sits on navy (5.85:1, decorative, fine) but `accent` is the darkened #8C6A29, because accent lands in 12px meta text across the renderer and the brand gold measures only 2.73:1 on white — unreadable at that size. Same hue (39.7deg) and saturation, so it still reads as the brand. Verified: every foreground/background pairing in this palette clears WCAG AA.
